goals.handoff_rule: Name the actual outstanding item and responsible actor when one exists. A concise specific equivalent is valid; a generic any-work/any-owner statement is insufficient. Do not invent unfinished work when the current state has none.

style_rubric.task_expression: Assess claims and task completion separately from expression. Use the concrete history to assess clarity, boundedness and scene-appropriate tone; copying words is not evidence of understanding.
style_rubric.current_exception: A reader's humor or terse style does not settle their current request; read the current question and followup.
style_rubric.unsupported: Do not infer hostility, approval, identity or permission from style alone.

anchors.0: Dismissive, mocking, misleading or copied irrelevant catchphrase
anchors.2: Relevant, clear and consistent with supplied habits while adapting to the current problem

critical_violations: False causal or safety certainty unsupported by supplied evidence
judging: Manual semantic judgment of actual text and state is required. The pass_condition examples describe the substance, not mandatory wording or action order. G1-G4 remain a fixed denominator. New easy replies cannot add goals. Future facts do not retroactively invalidate an earlier justified statement; they create maintenance duties once visible. Failure, not_applicable and undetermined must be distinguished.
